name: TC-03-master-data-department
description: TC-03.1: Create Department linked to Site

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Department List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Department. Departments are organizational units within a site, used for cost allocation and team-level data scoping.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Add New
doc_metadata.caption: Click the Add New button to open the creation form.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Fill Department Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Department X" into the Department Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Department Saved
doc_metadata.caption: The department is created and linked to its parent site. Departments are used for team-level data scoping (scope=team) in the RBAC system.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the department with its site linkage.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Hierarchy Complete
doc_metadata.caption: With Organization → Site → Department created, the organizational hierarchy is established. This hierarchy is used for data scoping, cost allocation, and reporting.
